precepts.text: We left our name for a curse, American, Jamaican, Jones, Williams, the names of the slave master; that man in Isaiah 4:1 is teaching you your real name, which comes with your nation and your God.
precepts.point: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful: when you sisters change, the branches of the Lord will be beautiful when the Lord returns, what we celebrate in Tabernacles with the goodly boughs and branches; and it is for them that are escaped of Israel.

note.label: 7 WOMAN SHALL TAKE HOLD OF ONE MAN

precepts.text: The other name is American, black, Negro, Hispanic, Latino, Puerto Rican, Haitian, Papua New Guinean: none of it is in the Bible, and now the Most High woke us up through our leadership to show our people their nationality according to the Bible.
precepts.point: An astonishment means people look at your condition in disbelief; a proverb means slick sayings, your suffering becomes an example; a byword is being called outside your God-given name.

note.label: You Are Hated And In Hell

precepts.text: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts. Our people walk after their own thoughts, and their thoughts are the thoughts these man made religions gave them: do not keep any laws. Those vipers hatch eggs, and little vipers come out.
precepts.point: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace. You follow the Democratic or the Republican party, you follow the cross and the idols, you are not going to find peace. Our people have made crooked paths for themselves.

note.label: The Negro Community: A Wasteland of Tears

precepts.why:
“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. See what our people do: they walk after their own thoughts. They don't give a damn what the Bible says; I do what I want to do.

And their thoughts are the white man's thoughts. Our people follow all these man-made religions, and they don't teach God's laws, his commandments, his statutes. We ain't got to keep no laws, because that is what all these white people were teaching: don't keep no laws.

So what do you get? Those vipers hatch eggs, and what comes out? Little vipers, little snakes. Your son, little Tyrone, is a snake, and your daughter, little Chenique, was a snake too. That is what God is saying in Isaiah 59:5, and it is why verse 7 says “their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity”: a rebellious people walking after their own thoughts.

precepts.text: Found of them that sought me not, a nation not called by my name; a rebellious people walking after their own thoughts in Christianity and Islam, sacrificing in gardens, eating swine's flesh and broth of abominable things, and saying stand by thyself, I am holier than thou, washed in the blood: a smoke in his nose.
precepts.point: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity, Miss Laura included, and all that prey upon thee shall be a prey. For I will restore health unto thee: only the Lord heals, by Christ's stripes, for they that are whole need no physician and he came to call sinners to repentance. Because they call thee an outcast, African-American, Haitian, Jamaican, this is Zion whom no man seeketh after.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
This goes with Christ saying he came not for the righteous but for sinners. “I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not”. Like the disciples, we didn't wake up one day as kids searching for the Lord of heaven and earth. The word was introduced to us and woke us up.

“I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.” We are called African-Americans, Haitians, Jamaicans, Puerto Ricans. That is a nation not called by his name.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. We are that rebellious people, walking in Christianity and Islam, our people following their own thoughts in these religions. “A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick”: the churches and mosques. Then: “which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels”. You know that's the church: there was always a swine fest at the end, pig feet and all of that; possum soup, turtle soup.

“Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou.” That is what the churches say to the Israelites on the street preaching: stand by yourself, I don't need no black Jesus, I'm washed in the blood of Jesus, I'm water baptized, I'm holier than thou. “These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.” God can't stand them.

That is the people Jeremiah calls an Outcast, “This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.” Those who think they are whole push away the physician; the sick who admit it are the ones he heals.

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, and he shall call his servants by another name.
precepts.point: Israel became an astonishment, a proverb and a byword, called by names other than the one God gave. Israel means prince with God; there is no greater name.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 28:37 says Israel would become “an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations”: called by names outside of our God-given name. God gave us a name. Israel means prince of the power with God, and there is no mightier name on the face of the earth. Why would you want to call yourself a Latinized negro, a Latino? That is a racist term. You have to do the history and get the knowledge; you have to find yourself so you don't lose yourself.

Isaiah 65:15 says the same: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen.” We left the name Israel for a curse, for racist terms like Latino, Hispanic, and names like Cuban, Colombian, Venezuelan, Dominican. Yet it is “unto my chosen”: we are God's chosen people. You have to see the greatness in who you are. We have fallen so far that we think we can't come out of it, but we are coming out, because there is a God.

“for the Lord God shall slay thee”. For wanting a king of another nation over us, for wanting to assimilate, the Most High slew us and caused the basest of men to rule over us. “and call his servants by another name”: now we are called Latino, blacks, spics, wetbacks, illegal aliens. That is why we do not know who we are, a confusion of faces. We are searching, but we are not searching the scriptures.

So-called Latinos, you are the Israelites. Latino is not your given name; your name is Israel, the twelve tribes of Israel. You think this is a black movement, a negro movement, but the twelve tribes of Israel are mainly so-called Latinos. We have to get back to our history and our true nationality.

precepts.text: Can we read verse 37 again: the proverb and byword are Gentile names, Gentile identities.
precepts.point: So the proverb and byword are Gentile names, Gentile identities.

note.label: Jews and Gentiles

precepts.text: Why is it saying that the Israelites that sacrifice in gardens remain among the graves: the man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
precepts.point: Which say, stand by thyself: we try to bring the truth to you, and they go, no, stand by yourself, brother, come not near to me, you don't got to come near me with that Bible, for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose means it makes God angry; he can't stand you that say you're so holy. You always got that elder in the church, that mother of the church who says I'm Holy Ghost filled, I'm washed in the blood of the lamb, I'm sanctified: that's the Negro that says I'm holier than thou. Don't come near me with that Israel stuff, I know it all, and won't keep commandment one.

note.label: Your Pastor

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen; we became a byword and lost our name in the captivity.
precepts.point: Thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all nations: Puerto Rican, Dominican, Haitian, Jamaican, African American, gentile. We lost our name and left it for a curse, like it says in Isaiah, while others wear the name and cry anti-Semitic.

note.label: Deuteronomy 28: The Blessings and the Curses That Identify Israel

precepts.why:
“The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone. And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.” Puerto Rican, Dominican, Haitian, Jamaican, African American, gentile: those are the bywords. We lost our name in the captivity.

Isaiah says how: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name”. We left our name for a curse and became a byword among the nations, while others wear the name and cry anti-Semitic. Carried to a nation our fathers never knew, serving other gods of wood and stone, called by every name but our own: that is what becoming a proverb and a byword looks like.

precepts.text: His servants who keep His commandments shall eat, drink, and rejoice, but those who refuse the truth shall be hungry, thirsty, and ashamed.
precepts.point: He shall visit his habitation and not sin. Peace and security come to the man the Most High keeps.

note.label: Job 5: The Most High Corrects and Delivers His Righteous

precepts.why:
“At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.” The Lord shows who laughs at famine: “Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed”.

His servants who keep his commandments shall eat, drink, and rejoice, but those who refuse the truth shall be hungry, thirsty, and ashamed. The beasts of the earth point to the zoonosis of these days, Ebola, coronavirus, and the sicknesses created from splitting genes, and the righteous stay strong and steadfast in his truth. Peace and security come to the man the Most High keeps: his tabernacle is in peace, and he visits his habitation and does not sin.

precepts.text: Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, for the Lord shall slay thee and call his servants by another name; our names were left for a curse in slavery.
precepts.point: This is prophecy of our name being changed back: on the sabbath classes a member is announced no longer a Corinthian or an Ephesian, because they take a pen and legalize their name change, subscribing with the hand as the scripture said.

note.label: Isaiah 44: The Idol Maker's Folly and the Changed Name

precepts.why:
“One shall say, I am the Lord’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.” This is prophecy of our name being changed back, and Isaiah 65 shows how it was lost: “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name”.

Ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen, for the Lord shall slay thee and call his servants by another name. Our names were left for a curse in slavery. So when the Most High pours his spirit upon Jacob’s seed and his blessing upon his offspring, they surname themselves by the name of Israel again. On the sabbath classes a member is announced no longer a Corinthian or an Ephesian, because they take a pen and legalize their name change, subscribing with the hand as the scripture said.

precepts.text: "I am found of them that sought me not," the northern kingdom that began to seek him.
precepts.point: The restoration is two sticks made one nation. Ephraim, once "not a people," is called back and named the sons of the living God, having obtained mercy that they had not obtained, so the Gentiles being brought in are the outcasts of Israel that Christ came to be a light to.

note.label: Acts 10: Cornelius and the Northern Kingdom Grafted In

precepts.why:
“I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.”

That is the northern kingdom, which began to seek him. Ephraim was “not a people”, a nation no longer called by his name, and still he was found of them.

note.label: The Keys Of Hell & Death: The Lake Of Fire

precepts.why:
I know what you’re thinking: God ain’t going to judge me for eating pork. Here’s the prophecy.

“I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.” That’s us, our people today, because we’re not called Israel. We’re called African-American, Puerto Rican, Haitian, Jamaican, Brazilian and so forth: the new names the slave master gave us when they overcame us, like it said in Revelation 13:7.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. Our people walk after their own thoughts, and their thoughts is what the white man says. “A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens”: in the gardens of churches, “and burneth incense upon altars of brick”.

“Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels”.

“Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me”: no brother, we don’t need that, we don’t need to hear that Israelite teaching. “For I am holier than thou”: I’m water baptized, I’m washed in the blood of the Lamb. “These are a smoke in my nose”, meaning God can’t stand them, “a fire that burneth all the day.”

note.label: Pride & Divine Judgment

precepts.why:
This is for the holier-than-thou. Brothers put on their fringes and the frenemies out there say, ‘you trying to be holier than thou for wearing fringes’. No, that’s the commandment of the Lord.

“I am sought of them that asked not for me”: that’s us. We did not ask for the Lord; we had no idea about a black God, a black savior, or that we are the children of Israel. All our lives we worshipped this white man and his idols. “I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name”: the nation not called by God’s name is African-American, Puerto Rican, Jamaican, Haitian, Brazilian.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people”: we are the rebellious people, “which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts”. Those last four words: our people walk after their own thoughts. That’s the world we live in today. “That sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick”: the little churches we set up, the same as the people worshipping under the trees in Papua New Guinea. “Which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels”: our people eat pork and all manner of unclean foods in these churches.

Here’s the point: “Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou.” Get away from me, don’t bring that Bible over here: ‘I’m water baptized, Holy Ghost filled, washed in the blood of the Lamb.’ That’s them. It’s hard to say, but it’s nine out of ten black women doing that: I am so holy, and then turn out to be the biggest whores on the planet, sucking the deacon down. Growing up in church, me and my brother hiding in the basement, look what Pastor doing. So don’t talk about Christian churches; they make me want to vomit.

“These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.” When you’ve got smoke in your nose you can’t stand it. God is saying, I can’t stand these people, they make me sick. That is the Pharisee of Luke 18:11, holier than the brother beside him.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why: The angel cast the prayers of the saints into the earth, and there were voices, thunderings, lightnings and an earthquake: that is going into our prayers being answered immediately. Sometimes you pray and it seems like the Lord doesn't answer; it is like he ain't listening. But there is going to come a day, and Isaiah prophesies this thing right here. “And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.” That right there is evidence: that day, when Raphael takes the prayers of the saints and casts them to the earth, our prayer is going to be answered immediately. We are in the midst of speaking and the Lord is going to say, I'm answering that already. Can't you wait for that day?

note.label: ​ | Sabbath Evening Class: Secrets in the Lord's Prayer

precepts.why: “Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat”: my servants shall eat, “but ye shall be hungry”: but you rebellious Israelites shall be hungry. That’s what the Bible prophesies. “Behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed”. The Lord’s servants are going to eat; don’t get it twisted.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

precepts.why: He ain’t going to destroy all of us. “Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it”. The blessing in the cluster is those who fear the Lord. That is the saving of the house of Jacob in Amos 9:8.

note.label: | Explaining Dark Sentences | Part 3

precepts.why:
“For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind. But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.” That new heaven and new earth is what we just read in 2 Esdras 6: Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.

“And the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying. There shall be no more thence an infant of days”: no more children dying in childbirth, “nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old”: that’s going to the other nations. “But the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed”: that’s the other nations; that ain’t talking about Israel.

“They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat”: the curses of Deuteronomy 28:15 on will be finished. “For as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands. They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.”

How many children? It said the women are going to bring forth children in three or four months. That’s about four children a year from one woman, and you got seven women to one man. There it is.

“And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear. The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.”

note.label: What's The 1000 Year Reign?

precepts.why: Here’s another precept that goes with what we just read, the wolf again: “The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.” The same covenant with the beasts, the same peace in the thousand years.

note.label: LEARNING TO SEE WITH SPIRITUAL EYES | Psalm 23

precepts.why: The precept to explain that verse: we lost our minds. “And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen”: we left the name of Israel for a curse. Now we’re African-American, Dominican, Haitian, Jamaican, Honduran; those are curses. “For the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name”.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 22

precepts.why: In the coming kingdom: “And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.” The communication will be open for us with the Most High and his Son. You have a thought, and he already knows it.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 21 Thy Kingdom Come

precepts.why: What Isaiah prophesied. “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth”: that’s what we just read in Revelation 21:1. “I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy”: the Lord is going to change everything. “The voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her”: ain’t going to be no more stillbirths, no more miscarriages. “The child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed”: this goes with the other nations and those of our people that’s not part of that first resurrection. “They shall not build, and another inhabit”: those days of captivity ain’t happening no more. “Before they call, I will answer”: you think he don’t listen; on this day he said before they call I will answer. “The wolf and the lamb shall feed together”: that’s how you know this is the kingdom. Moses said the Lord will remove all evil beasts out of the land, so he is going to change the whole nature. “They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain”: the other nations are going to be at their very lowest state.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

precepts.why:
“Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth”: the plagues, death, famine and destruction, will not be slack. “And the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.” Things are not going to go back to how they used to be. It is going to get worse. Watch the news: war and killing and genocide all over the place, not just in Palestine.

“O my people, hear my word”: the words of God come through the prophets. “Make you ready to thy battle”: the prophets are letting you know to be ready for the war that is about to take place, when the dragon comes against us. Read on and it says in those evils to be as pilgrims: you must be willing to up and leave; you cannot stay in one place, because there will be destruction on every side.

How do you make ready for the battle? You become spiritually strong: you study, pray, apply, and build your spirit up. Because in that battle some of us will die, and that is not a bad thing.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

precepts.why:
“For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.” This is future prophecy. If there is famine, why are they taking our goods? Because we prepared. It will be like the walking dead, people hunting for who has food. Some of us will have our goods taken, some our houses, and our children will become captives.

“And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery”: they will be robbing us. Those of you that have food, they will try to rob you. You do not just buy a bunch of food and have nothing to protect your family with; remember what Christ told Peter and the apostles, and read between the lines.

During famine and that civil war they will take some of our goods and some of our houses. That is why you must be willing to make moves and up and leave when things get hot in the city or community you build. We must be building self-sustaining communities, storing food that can last us years, because we do not know how long Jacob’s trouble is going to take. “The more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons”, “the more will I be angry with them”.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
Hold Isaiah 65 and get Isaiah 60:21. “Thy people also shall be all righteous”: all Israel is going to be righteous.

So when we go back to Isaiah 65:20, the child dying an hundred years old and the sinner being accursed is not talking about us. We will be immortal and all righteous; it’s the nations that die and the sinner that is accursed.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
Why would the other nations live so long? Everything’s going to be on another level, brothers and sisters. “In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits”: that goes to the twelve tribes of Israel. “And yielded her fruit every month”: every month there’s going to be some understanding that comes out.

“And the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.” If the nations obey, they going to live. That’s why we read in Isaiah 65 that there shall be no more an infant of days, and the child shall die an hundred years old.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

precepts.why:
A quick precept on the nations obeying. “And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles”: everybody going to obey God’s laws.

“And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain”: that means they’re going to die. That’s what we were just reading in Isaiah 65 about them dying an hundred years old. If they obey, they’re going to live a little longer.

“And if the family of Egypt go not up”: if Egypt decide we ain’t going up, “and come not, that have no rain”, they going to have a famine, a drought, and die. “There shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.” If the nations will not obey, there’s going to be plagues on them; they’re going to die.

points: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom. Serving other gods on the hills blasphemed him.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: An infant of days is not a baby; it is being a hundred or two hundred years old, and there will be no more of that because we will live for ever.
Only the Father is the Ancient of days, with no beginning and no end; with us it is the infant of days that is taken away.
The child that dies a hundred years old and the sinner accursed at a hundred years old are the nations, who still carry the sinful nature that is removed from the elect.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

points: There's a scripture where it says we would leave our name for a curse.
It's letting us know prophetically that Israel would lose their identity and we would be called by other names, like …, like Greeks, like Romans. That is the prophecy.
Which goes back to Deuteronomy 28. I want the listener to understand prophetically the Israelites would lose their identities and be called Gentile names.
So the proverb and byword are Gentile names, Gentile identities.

note.label: Jews and Gentiles

points: The people you're talking to walk after their own thoughts. They don't want to hear what the Bible says.
That's how you know they're not the disciples of the Lord. They are not the servants of the Lord at all.

note.label: What Is the Holy Ghost?

points: Listen good, black man, black woman: the Israelites forget the holy mountain of God.

That prepare a table for that troop: what is that talking about? Thanksgiving. Just like many of you so-called Native American Indians who are destroyed and brainwashed, you prepared a table for those that overcame you. You so-called blacks do the same thing, and you call it Thanksgiving Day, the last Thursday of every November.

And that furnish the drink offering unto that number. You ever wonder why the Thanksgiving meal is the turkey, the stuffing, the cranberry sauce, the apple cider? History tells you that the first time they sat down, those foods were not there to be eaten. Everything the so-called white man does has a metaphoric meaning behind it.

The turkey represents the body, the overcoming of the tribe of Gad. The cranberry sauce represents the spilling of their blood. The stuffing, because they did many unspeakable atrocities to our people: they would cut off the breasts of the Indian women and play baseball with them.

They would cut off their heads and carry them to get money, but they realized that was too much, so they cut off their scalps. A lot of you unlearned say the Indians started scalping people. No, they did that when the white man started doing that to them. Read a book, please. Get a clue, you brainwashed Negroes.

note.label: The Truth of Thanksgiving

points: I am sought of them that asked not for me: he's prophesying about Israelites scattered in other lands that don't really know about the Lord. Their spirit would move them to seek the one true God, like you're seeing today.

A nation that was not called by my name: the name is Israel. The scattered Israelites that were brought to America and all the scattered lands are no longer called Israel. We're called American black, West Indian black, Haitian, Puerto Rican, Mexican, Panamanian, Nicaraguan.

note.label: Your Pastor

points: The rebellious people is the twelve tribes of Israel, you right there at home. Blacks and Latinos, you walk in a way that is not good: keep following that Negro in the pulpit. You walk after your own thoughts. We as a people provoke the Lord to anger every day at his face, because when the law is brought out we go, oh no, I ain't doing that. Why? My pastor told me I don't got to do that.

note.label: Your Pastor

points: You got to know history. Before there was such a thing as buildings called churches, back in ancient times they were called gardens. People would cut down a tree, and the stump in the middle of the garden they would shape into a god, a Roman or Greek or Babylonian or Egyptian god, and people would come and offer sacrifices. Today what is this called? You call them churches. Which remain among the graves: what's in graveyards? The dead. You're in your churches sacrificing to a false god, a white god, so you remain amongst the graves.

Which eat swine's flesh: pork, chitlins, pig intestines, hog jowls. Oh, I know, your pastor said what God has cleansed we can eat it, you simple Negroes and Latinos. Broth of abominable things: in the South they have broths of abominable things, possum stew, rabbit stew, turtle stew.

note.label: Your Pastor

points: Which say, stand by thyself: we try to bring the truth to you, and they go, no, stand by yourself, brother, come not near to me, you don't got to come near me with that Bible, for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose means it makes God angry; he can't stand you that say you're so holy. You always got that elder in the church, that mother of the church who says I'm Holy Ghost filled, I'm washed in the blood of the lamb, I'm sanctified: that's the Negro that says I'm holier than thou. Don't come near me with that Israel stuff, I know it all, and won't keep commandment one.

note.label: Your Pastor

points: Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name: originally we wasn't called by the name of the Lord. When we was called by the name of the Lord was around the time Jacob got his name changed. Before that we were just a people: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, then the 12 tribes.

note.label: Israel's Rebellion Doesn't Stop the Promise!!

points: Which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts: we used to walk after our own thoughts. But remember when we was in Egypt, he said Israel is my son, even my firstborn. We was his from the beginning, don't get it twisted. We was his long time ago. But he's making this comparison because we did not consider, like Isaiah chapter one. We didn't know our owner.

note.label: Israel's Rebellion Doesn't Stop the Promise!!

points: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face: we continually make him mad.

note.label: Israel's Rebellion Doesn't Stop the Promise!!

points: Which eat swine's flesh: namely that pig that Israel loved so much, northern and southern kingdom. We love that damn pork. Can't leave it alone. Some of us would actually die before we gave it up. That's a rebellious nation. But what about those that are eating it now that are going to get repentance later? That's why we need his patience and his mercy.

note.label: Israel's Rebellion Doesn't Stop the Promise!!

points: Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou: that's the Christian church. We was doing a community clean up in Ghana one time. The Christian church was right there as we cleaning up. We said hello, how you doing? They turned their nose up at us. And we out there cleaning up they community.

note.label: Israel's Rebellion Doesn't Stop the Promise!!

points: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: so this is the kingdom to come, right?

note.label: Exposing The Elect

points: For, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy: so why is Jerusalem rejoicing, if all nations and kingdoms is going to be in the kingdom of heaven? Why is Jerusalem just rejoicing? Is that a typo? And why is he joying in his people, which a couple chapters back in Isaiah 45 he said are the elect?

note.label: Exposing The Elect

points: For the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed: so our children are going to live forever. But the sinner, the other nations, they got a certain amount of time and they're dead. That's why they're not rejoicing. They're not the elect.

note.label: Exposing The Elect

points: Let's walk this a little further, because there's countless videos like that of people asking on blogs, on websites, on YouTube videos, on social media, who are the elect? Well, let's find out.

For as the days of a tree are the days of my people: trees be around for a long time. It been trees that's been here for thousands of years. That's how we going to be in the kingdom. But look what it calls those people that are going to be rejoicing, that are going to inhabit houses and plant vineyards, and they're going to grow and they're going to live forever.

And mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands: my elect. So that's why they going to be rejoicing, because they are the elect, and they're going to be immortal. They're going to live forever. Now, somebody might say, "Well, that's the Old Testament. When Christ came, he changed all of that." I want to show y'all something, what Christ said about the elect.

note.label: Exposing The Elect

points: Now I know they thinking God don’t feel like that. Here is how God feels about Christians.

“I am sought of them that asked not for me”: our people never asked for the Lord. “I am found of them that sought me not”: we were in slavery. “I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.” Why were we not called by God’s name? We were not called by the name of Israel anymore, because we were called African, African-American, Jamaican, Haitian, Puerto Rican, Brazilian. They changed our identity. That’s what it means.

note.label: The Chemarims & Caterpillars For Gaza

points: “I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people”: we are that rebellious people, “which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts.” Our people walk after their own thoughts.

note.label: The Chemarims & Caterpillars For Gaza

points: “Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me”: because we try to give them the truth, and they say, stand by yourself. Brother, don’t give me no flyer. Sister, I don’t want to hear what you got. “For I am holier than thou”: I’m Holy Ghost filled and water baptized, I am washed in the blood of the Lamb.

“These are a smoke in my nose”: God can’t stand them. Smoke in your nose is when you can’t breathe, you can’t stand it. “A fire that burneth all the day”: that is God’s anger. So my anger is God’s anger, although I can never be as angry as he is. My anger is a little thing.

note.label: The Chemarims & Caterpillars For Gaza

points: This is for every one of you that eat that turkey and all the leftovers. Thanksgiving is thanks-killing, the murder of our brothers. “But ye are they that forsake the Lord”: what makes you forsake the Lord? “That forget my holy mountain”: you forgot that you are one of the twelve tribes of Israel, you forgot that the North American Indians are your brothers, of the nation of Israel. You forgot who you are.

“That prepare a table for that troop”: in forgetting who you are you prepare a table. This is talking about the Thanksgiving table, prepared for that troop: Andrew Jackson, the US Cavalry troop that destroyed the North American Indians. The families always say we’re just giving thanks to God. No, you ain’t thanking the God of the Bible; you thanking the devil.

“And that furnish the drink offering unto that number”: the number of our people that was murdered here in America, over 70 million North American Indians. That’s what you are celebrating. America was established on bloodshed, and on that day you give glory and praise to the god of this world, to Satan, for giving the so-called white man the power to kill and murder your brothers.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter”: every last one of you that celebrates Thanksgiving will die; the Lord is going to kill you when he returns. So no turkey, no leftover turkey, no leftover stuffing in your mother’s fridge tomorrow. Wait till next month and make some turkey. When you do it on that day you are celebrating the murder of your people, and God is going to kill you in the end.

note.label: Thankskilling Get Away: A Sign of The World

points: “Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer”. These are our people that are unbelieving and unfaithful. How does the Most High call our people? Through the prophets: by us going on the street and teaching, by the videos you run across. But you turn away your face, shut your ears, and say these guys are crazy. You did not repent; you did not hear the high calling of God.

“When I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes”: our people stay in the midst of their sins, following Christianity, following another God, worshipping the beast. They “did choose that wherein I delighted not.” God does not delight in the Christian religion, in Judaism, or in being a Muslim, yet that is what they choose.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

points: “Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed”. We warn the people to repent, that death, famine and destruction are coming, and they do not listen.

On the basic level: famine is coming. Those that believe the Lord and believe the prophets will prepare, as Joseph did. Joseph interpreted the dream of Egypt’s king, understood famine was coming, and prepared, and the Lord used him to save a lot of people. God is not coming down to feed you. My servants shall eat means the leaders will make sure the people prepare for what is coming, so when that time comes you will not be hungry and you will not thirst.
But our people in the world making a mockery of us never prepared. When things get bad on this earth, they are going to try to rob us, to steal our houses and our goods.

note.label: War With The Beast: Death & Persecution

points: The party ain’t over. “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.” “For, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.”

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

points: “And the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.” This is what we read in Isaiah 60, and this is Revelation 20:4.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

points: “There shall be no more thence an infant of days”: meaning no more stillbirths, stillborns and premature births. “Nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old”.

In the Kingdom are we going to be dropping dead? No. We’re going to be immortal, and Israel shall be all righteous (Isaiah 60:21). So this ain’t talking about us. “But the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed”: are we going to be sinners? We going to be all righteous. This is the nations.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

points: “And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.” Who’s going to be planting and doing all of this? The nations. “They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people”: we want to live long. “And mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.”

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

points: “They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.”

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

points: “And it shall come to pass, that before they call”, before we send our prayer, “I will answer”: the Lord said I will answer. “And while they are yet speaking”, while we yet speaking in our prayer, “I will hear.”

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem

points: “The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.” That’s Isaiah 60; that’s Revelation 20:4.

note.label: Ashke-Nazis - Blow Up Gaza & New Jerusalem
